paper.title: Look Before You Move: Agent-Interface-Aligned Supervision for Open-World Mobile Manipulation
paper.central_claim: Agent-interface-aligned privileged-teacher demonstrations, active target acquisition, spatial reasoning labels and a shared harness teach a VLM mobile manipulation: 71.76% on 170 held-out OWMM episodes, 38% real-robot success without additional training, and applicability to EmbodiedBench navigation.

evidence.quote: we assume a pre-mapped environment and known robot localization.
evidence.support_explanation: Deployment is not unconstrained open-world discovery; maps and localization are available to executor.

evidence.quote: Simulator masks, poses, projected paths, and bearings support these decisions during data collection.
evidence.support_explanation: Teacher is privileged rule logic, not a frontier model self-generating supervision.

evidence.quote: It generates this reasoning offline using deterministic templates and the simulator information recorded during collection.
evidence.support_explanation: Supervision contains privileged state labels; recoverability from RGB/history needs checking.

evidence.quote: Privileged simulator information is excluded from the prompt in both training and inference.
evidence.support_explanation: Privilege is in target labels, not student input; training and inference share schema.

evidence.quote: we evaluate on 170 held-out episodes in pre-mapped simulated homes.
evidence.support_explanation: Counted closed-loop simulated task outcomes, but held-out scenes are not independently guaranteed by this phrase.

evidence.quote: OWMM, relabeled 152,478 38.8% AIDA: distance-greedy 28,480 46.3% AIDA: visibility-aware 28,480 65.5% AIDA: target recovery 28,480 69.6%
evidence.support_explanation: Matched AIDA sample counts isolate navigation-teacher behavior better than mismatched-model headline comparison.

evidence.quote: Search only None No 60.00% Search only Actions No 65.88% Search only Actions Yes 71.76%
evidence.support_explanation: Conditional additions support history/reasoning utility, not a full factorial isolation of interactions.

evidence.locator: Appendix A collection/filtering; fixed text line 27
evidence.quote: collection attempts cover 13,608 episodes, of which 11,740 succeed. Removing 1,528 successful episodes longer than 16 steps leaves 10,212 episodes and 67,183 training examples.
evidence.support_explanation: Teacher acceptance and horizon selection are explicit; hard/long trajectories are selectively removed.

evidence.quote: Evaluation uses 60 episodes from each of the base and common_sense splits, with results averaged over two runs.
evidence.support_explanation: Cross-simulator navigation outcomes have a trial denominator.

evidence.quote: the OWMM-trained policy reaches 0.55 without additional training
evidence.support_explanation: Unchanged OWMM policy transfers to navigation in AI2-THOR; distinct from separately EB-trained policy's 0.84.

evidence.quote: The robot achieves 38% end-to-end success with a 15-step horizon, including low-level grasp failures in the evaluation.
evidence.support_explanation: Reports physical outcome percentage, but exact physical trial totals and per-task rates absent from local text.

evidence.quote: We train the three AIDA students with the same seed and report mean success over three evaluations of the 170 episodes.
evidence.support_explanation: Repeated evaluations exist; independent training seeds and confidence intervals do not.

evidence.quote: generalization is bounded by the teacher data diversity across scenes, objects, embodiments, sensors, and skills.
evidence.support_explanation: Explicitly limits broad acquisition and robustness claims.

signatures.information: Teacher sees masks, poses, projected paths and bearings; student sees RGB, instruction, prior calls and key frames; executor holds depth/map/localization
signatures.operation: Rule teacher chooses search/turn/nav/pick/place in student vocabulary after each resulting observation; maintains visibility and recovers lost target
signatures.conditions: Premapped scenes; known pose; simplified simulation attachment grasp; thresholds and short horizons
signatures.feedback: Simulator outcome and per-step visual/state feedback
signatures.selection_rule: Keep successful episodes, then discard those longer than 16 steps
signatures.persistence: Offline training set then LoRA adapter
signatures.later_use: Trained student selects skills without privileged rule teacher; no online self-improvement
signatures.claimed_effect: Better full-task success than trajectory-relabeling/greedy-teacher data
signatures.failure_boundary: Teacher diversity and lack of on-policy correction; long/hard trajectories filtered

signatures.object: Student reasoning targets and harness context
signatures.information: Offline annotator sees recorded ground truth; deployment student must infer target state from current RGB/history
signatures.operation: Template visibility/direction/readiness/progress labels; SFT Qwen3-VL-8B with consistent action-history schema
signatures.output: Reasoning followed by typed skill call/arguments
signatures.conditions: Spatial labels identifiable from deployment observations; reliable frozen executors
signatures.feedback: Offline cross-entropy supervision; simulator and physical outcome evaluation
signatures.selection_rule: Fixed SFT, not retained harness search; train-time validation disabled per Appendix D
signatures.selection_data: 67,183 examples for main/harness variants; teacher sensitivity uses 28,480 each
signatures.persistence: LoRA weights; episode action history only, generated summary not recursively reused
signatures.later_use: Student deployment in same interface and zero-shot cross-simulator reference
signatures.claimed_effect: History and spatial labels improve success to 71.76%
signatures.failure_boundary: Out-of-view privileged labels may not be identifiable; no factor-interaction isolation

gap.author_gap: Trajectory chunks driven by shortest-path progress undersupervise where to look and when ready to manipulate.
gap.checked_gap: Table 2's fixed student/interface and equal-size AIDA variants directly support a visibility/recovery deficit, while headline differences from OWMM systems include model and skill differences.

lineage.relation: OWMM-Agent trajectory relabeling and active perception precede interface-native teacher decisions; spatial-VLM state labels become policy targets.

closest_adjacent.source: OWMM-Agent [2] as described/reused by this paper
closest_adjacent.limitation: Only author descriptions and imported baseline numbers available; no independent novelty audit of original OWMM source.

gap.residue: Shortest geometric progress does not preserve visibility or teach target recovery/manipulation readiness.
gap.stakes: Picking is the largest improvement stage; physical grasp reliability still limits deployment.
gap.method_response: Collect decisions at deployed skill granularity and train spatial state plus history.
gap.remaining_gap: Privileged-label identifiability, contact-rich grasping, long-horizon navigation and unbiased hard-task coverage.
unresolved: Need shared fixed nearest-neighbor originals if precise novelty is decisive; not independently retrieved.

rs_pattern.reason: Read self_supervised_signal_engineering and decompose_and_delegate/C25 as closest candidates. AIDA's main innovation is privileged simulator-rule collection aligned to an existing skill interface. It does not derive labels from a model's own outputs/uncertainty (self-supervised parent fails), nor introduce solver-check/repair at a novel decomposition boundary (C25 fails). Conventional supervised skill execution alone is not enough to relabel the training contribution as delegation; overview's other 13 signatures likewise do not describe this operation. Domain card fits without forcing original taxonomy.

condition_checks.reason: Teacher actually executes the deployed skill calls, not posthoc trajectory labels.
Known localization and short teacher/episode horizons are disclosed.
No observation-conditioned label ambiguity or learned substitute experiment.
Limited scene/skill diversity and 38% physical outcome acknowledged.

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: No original-main fit; domain operation is rule teacher using privileged state in learner action interface and template-annotated reasoning.
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_and_differences: Ground-truth deterministic supervision is not model-manufactured label-free signal; pre-existing skill controllers are not a new solver-verification mechanism.

expectations.reason: Collection/acceptance/length exclusion totals supplied, but task-difficulty selection distribution not reported.

expectations.applies_when: Privileged teacher labels absent from deployment observations
expectations.reason: Reasoning removal tested conditionally; no out-of-view identifiability test or label-content perturbation.
Rule teacher, not frontier teacher parity claim; collection success is not an identically evaluated teacher performance row. Base student comparison still checked on EB.
Equal-size teacher variants persuasive; harness additions form a cumulative stack rather than leave-one-out/factorial ablation.
Three evaluations of teacher variants/two EB runs but one training seed and no intervals.
Examples, LoRA settings and decision caps given, but no training GPU hours, episode latency/tokens or dollar cost.
38% includes grasp failures, but text lacks exact per-task physical trial counts. Evidence-level transfer rests on counted cross-simulator EB experiment, not this percentage alone.

claims.text: AIDA active-vision/interface data improve learned OWMM success
claims.setting: 170 held-out episodes; Qwen3-VL-8B LoRA, four fixed skills for sensitivity; five for main
claims.baseline/control: Trajectory relabeled 152,478 versus three equal AIDA sets of 28,480; same model, annotations, harness/executors
claims.selection_vs_test: Success/length-filtered collection versus held-out OWMM episodes; scene-level disjointness not explicit
claims.result/denominator: 38.8/46.3/65.5/69.6% means of three evaluations of 170; main 71.76% (approximately 122/170)
counterevidence: Headline OWMM prior rows use different models and reported results; cumulative harness ablations do not resolve interactions
claims.allowed_conclusion: Conditional evidence that active-vision rule-teacher demonstrations and spatial/history supervision improve this fixed learner; not pure attribution of 71.76 versus 21.9 to one module.

claims.text: Simulation-trained policy transfers without extra training
claims.setting: Atribot physical office and AI2-THOR EmbodiedBench
claims.baseline/control: EB shared prompt/parser/executor/horizon; separately trained EB policy not a transfer test
claims.selection_vs_test: OWMM-trained policy used unchanged on EB
claims.result/denominator: OWMM-trained EB average .55 on 60+60 episodes averaged twice; physical 38% at 15 steps without text trial count
counterevidence: Premapped office with manually selected keyframes; limited short navigation; physical count absent
claims.allowed_conclusion: Counted cross-simulator transfer to short navigation; physical qualitative/percentage evidence not a reliable general real-robot success estimate.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported controlled teacher-variant gains in closed-loop OWMM and unchanged OWMM-policy success on counted AI2-THOR navigation episodes support training utility and limited cross-simulator transfer. Physical deployment's 38% lacks local textual trial totals; broad open-world robustness is not established.
unresolved: Exact physical per-task trial counts require shared original outcome figure/material if decisive

G.reason: Explicit shortest-path/visibility bottleneck with targeted equal-size teacher comparisons; local lineage available only via paper.

M.reason: Teacher/executor/annotator/student separation and active-vision mechanism reconstructable; out-of-view label identifiability untested.

X.reason: Thresholds, filtering, SFT and matched schemas disclosed; assumptions and physical limitations explicit but recoverability and harder-state coverage incomplete.

measurement.reason: 170-episode full-task endpoint and counted EB trials support simulation; simulator grasp simplification and physical denominator missing limit strongest rating.

causality.reason: Fixed learner/executors and equal AIDA counts provide useful teacher intervention; imported headline baselines and cumulative harness stack leave confounds.

holdout.reason: Held-out OWMM and unchanged-policy AI2-THOR transfer; no exact scene-development disjointness or broad long-horizon claim verification.

statistics.reason: Episode denominators and some repeat means; no intervals, independent training seeds or detailed physical failure totals.

cost.reason: Sample counts and training/evaluation hyperparameters allow partial budgeting, not actual teacher/training/inference latency, tokens or compute expenditure.
search_scope: Entire text including Appendix D Table 5; no GPU-hour/wall-time/cost report

reason: Complete method and four appendices available; main simulation/training claim scoreable. Physical percentage is scoped, not promoted to counted physical transfer.
